R0052.title: Low Price, High Shipping
R0052.definition: A seller lists products at a relatively low price but compensates for the cost gap by inflating shipping fees.
R0052.description: This strategy may make products appear competitively priced to attract shoppers, but the seller actually earns more profit through excessive shipping charges.
R0052.influence: Shoppers may purchase items without noticing the high shipping fees, leading to a poor experience; for the platform, inflated shipping fees from sellers may damage the platform's reputation.

references.title: Provisions on Price Marking and Prohibition of Price Fraud - gov.cn
SAMR Promulgates Provisions on Price Marking and Prohibition of Price Fraud - State Administration for Market Regulation

observables: A single store lists products well below comparable prices while shipping fees run well above the industry average
The store's shipping template is set to a fixed amount far exceeding actual logistics costs
Product pages show low prices but shipping accounts for an abnormal share at checkout (e.g., shipping exceeds 30% of the item price)
Buyer complaints center on unnoticed or excessive shipping fees and cluster around a small number of stores
